evaluation_pose: final revision 188; one Sim(3) fitted on all 180 mapping-input camera centers only; no geometry fitting
gt_pose_diagnostic: replace each anchor rigid pose with GT; retain global-aligned predicted anchor scale; no local GT depth scale fitting
taxonomy_views: even original IDs 0,20,...,340 plus all five original KF IDs
candidate_placement: active candidates use exact persisted PLY world parameters, verified against original TF32 GPU bake; inactive raw candidates use float64 Sim(3) placement; CPU-vs-Ply placement discrepancy is recorded
tolerance_rule: max(abs_m, relative * GT z-depth); pilot operating values fixed before E1 measurements, not tuned performance thresholds
label_rule: front: >=2 reliable GT-view front conflicts with >=1 degree angular separation and zero support; valid: >=1 support and zero front conflicts; all other cases ambiguous; behind-surface alone is never front error
duplicate_rule: valid center near a valid center from an earlier KF with compatible nearest-GT-surfel normal; spatial redundancy proxy, no removal claim
projected_footprint: opacity * 2*pi*sqrt(det(J Sigma J^T + 0.3 I)) at the projected mean; repeated-front ellipsoid subset only; isolated mass proxy without transmittance, separate from actual composited class weights
render_views: all 180 odd original frame IDs; E0 validation 1..39, E0 held-out test 41..119, extension held-out diagnostic 121..359
render_depth: alpha-weighted expected camera z; covered if composited weight > 0.001
render_camera: same compiled upstream rasterizer; E1 evaluation wrapper applies exact fx,fy,cx,cy, including pixel-center convention; older E0 helper assumed centered principal point
split_policy: no held-out RGB or depth used to build candidate labels, fit alignment, choose thresholds, or update map; odd GT used only for final rendering evaluation
scope: single-scene descriptive pilot; center/ellipsoid/footprint are diagnostics, not a strict GT floater oracle; no efficacy, statistical significance, or research-wide GO claim
